title: Protect classroom capture and make the local release portable
summary: Follow-up audit found memory-only audio before stop, duplicate-start race, unbounded full-lecture decode and new-Windows startup dependency failures. Integration scope explicitly includes recorder, audio/translation runtime, native ASR setup launcher and assistant launch paths; no other writer is active. Keep accepted 0.4 online while hardening independently. Native Small bounded 60-second cores and draft protection added. Browser translation initialization also needs bounded waits.
acceptanceCriteria: Captured audio is durably journaled before stop; interrupted capture can recover without overwriting a finalized original
Permission/recording start is serialized and capture cleanup affects only the owning session
A timed long-live workload records actual transcription/translation queue and saved-audio evidence; untested boundaries remain explicit
Existing recordings/materials and old/new backups survive database changes in isolated tests
Normal Windows launch does not require injected PowerShell 7 or a Git checkout; absent Node/Codex produces actionable errors
Accepted code, GitHub and deployed versions stay aligned after gated integration
evidence: docs/coordination/HARDEN_ACCEPTANCE.md and tests/runtime/harden-evidence.json distinguish measured evidence from limitations
Actual App English eight Small segments/translations/four Codex items and Chinese six Small segments/three Codex items persisted through reload
24 Node and four Python tests passed; journal 29, backup 36, study storage 38, persistence six isolated browser checks passed
Frozen baseline two-hour live soak: 1779 segments, 857 translation batches, zero skipped; native two-hour sparse file bounded to 1024000 samples
Final native HTTP: three windows, cancellation with worker exit, malformed rejection; candidate draft preserves prior full text
vite v8.0.13 building client environment for production...
resultSummary: Verified 0.5: durable recording recovery, bounded Small ASR, actual Chinese/English Codex workflow, portable launch and hosted no-upload guards; documented limits
